text:
Maya Chen: Hey team — bringing up HF model `hf/xyz-1.0` as an embeddings + reranker candidate. After conversion to Redwood artifacts I'm seeing ~3.8% NDCG drop vs our HF baseline on the evaluation suite. Anyone seen a tokenization/pooling mismatch cause like this?
Noah Patel: Can you paste the conversion steps and the tokenizer/config.json you used?
Maya Chen: Converted with our hf-to-redwood script (v0.9.2). Tokenizer loaded from HF `AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained('hf/xyz-1.0')`. Redwood config we generated had `use_cls_pooling: true` by default. Quick snippets below.
Maya Chen: ```
# model config excerpt (from hf repo)
"special_tokens_map": {"bos_token": "<s>", "eos_token": "</s>"},
"cls_token": null,
"add_bos_token": true
```
Maya Chen: But our redwood pooling config assumed a CLS token present and pooled on token index 0. If `cls_token` is null HF might be using BOS or rolling pooling logic — that would shift pooling index.
Tariq Hussein: Also check chat templates. If we prefix with `"<s>system...<s>user"` or have prompt wrappers that add extra tokens, the pooling index for CLS/BOS changes. We saw exactly this with `hf/chat-templates-v2` where the trainer prepends meta tokens.
Tariq Hussein: Quick repro I run locally:
```python
from transformers import AutoTokenizer
tok = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained('hf/xyz-1.0')
print(tok('<s>user: hi'))
print(tok.convert_ids_to_tokens(tok('<s>user: hi')['input_ids']))
```
Tariq Hussein: On that model `input_ids[0]` is `<s>` (BOS) but no `<cls>` token, and our pooling code still looked for `<cls>` so used index 0 — semantically different pooling behavior.
Liz Romero: Did you try `add_special_tokens=False` when building embeddings for the eval? If HF baseline removed special tokens but our inference added them, that explains metric regressions.
Maya Chen: I checked — HF eval pipeline used `return_attention_mask=True, add_special_tokens=False` for the reranker embed steps. Our conversion defaulted to add special tokens.
Sean Park: Also worth verifying tokenization normalization differences: HF tokenizer might be `strip_accents=True` or have `tokenize_chinese_chars` toggles. Small token shifts change subword boundaries and downstream embedding pooling.
Maya Chen: Good catch. I ran a 200-sample diff comparing token ids and token strings between HF and Redwood tokenizers after conversion — ~12% of examples differ in token boundaries. The majority were due to `add_prefix_space` and `cls`/`bos` mismatch.
Maya Chen: Note: we also tested quantized weights (int8) for latency; quantization introduced a tiny additional regression (~0.3% NDCG) but not enough to explain the 3.8% drop. So root cause looks tokenization/pooling.
Noah Patel: Action items: (1) update hf-to-redwood converter to preserve `cls_token` vs `bos_token` semantics and emit explicit `pooling_token` config; (2) add a conversion check that simulates 50 eval prompts and compares token streams between HF and converted tokenizer; (3) document chat-template effects in onboarding checklist.
Maya Chen: Filed issue in infra: https://internal.redwood/infra/issues/7823 — description + sample diffs + small repro script. Assigning to @Tariq to add the simulation test.
Tariq Hussein: I'll add a unit test that runs `n=100` random eval samples, asserts token_id equality (mod known exceptions) and flags any `pooling_token` mismatch. Will also add a small helper to bake `pooling_token: "<s>"` or `"<cls>"` into the model metadata.
redwood-bot: Incident template created: infra/7823 — label: onboarding/regression.
Liz Romero: For immediate mitigation we can patch reranker to prefer mean-pooling over expecting a CLS token when model metadata is ambiguous — toggled by feature flag. That should recover most of the quality while we fix conversion.
Sean Park: +1 on mean-pooling fallback. Also log the exact token indices used for pooled vector in the console so we can correlate to eval diffs.
Maya Chen: Thanks all. I'll push a small PR that: flips `add_special_tokens` to match HF baseline for the eval harness, and exposes `pooling_token` in converted model metadata. PR link in the issue shortly.
Noah Patel: Awesome. After that, run the quant vs fp16 NDCG run again to isolate any remaining noise.
Maya Chen: Will do. TL;DR: primary discrepancy = special-token/CLS vs BOS misalignment + chat-template prefixes; quantization minor. Repro test and metadata fix in flight. :white_check_mark:
